newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Star Ent rights issue oversubscribed.
newsitem.headline: Star Ent rights issue oversubscribed.

text.p: Star Entertainment (International Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday its rights issue of 2.69 billion new shares was 1.4 times subscribed.
Star Entertainment said it received applications for 3.68 billion rights shares.

The company sought to raise HK$268.8 million through the issue of eight rights shares for every share held at HK$0.10 per rights share. It said proceeds would be used to finance film production, secure distribution rights and buy the rights of TV dramas. It also plans to build a video library.
